utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli. I’m still lining up helpers for Saturday on my front porch, and any extra hands would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there Saturday and help where I can. Just tell me what you need me to bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive this Saturday at the front porch. Just remind me what time you need me there, and I’ll do my best to show up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I need you there by 9 a.m. on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I can do Saturday morning, and I’m happy to take whatever porch task needs filling first. Put me where it helps most and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Saturday morning is a little tight for me, but if we can hold the porch jobs until after 10, I can make the schedule work.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely, I’m still in for Saturday at Sam’s front porch for the repair drive. I’ll check the time and get back to you so we can line up the helpers.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds good — just let me know the time and I’ll spread the word to the neighbors. We’ll make sure Sam’s repair drive has plenty of hands on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I can be there at the front porch after 10 on Saturday, and I’ll keep the schedule tidy once you slot me in.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rosa — after 10 on Saturday works for me. Just text me the exact time and I’ll be there if I can.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’ll be there on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Uli. I’ll let you know what to do when you get there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still lining up the Saturday porch schedule, so if you can tell me what time works for you, I’ll fit you in and keep the logistics straight.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Pia — I’m free Saturday afternoon, and I can help wherever you need me. Just send me the time and I’ll be there.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
